The Hidden Cost of America’s Bureaucracy
videos.description: In her new book The Time Tax, Atlantic staff writer Annie Lowrey examines how paperwork, delays and administrative hurdles consume Americans’ time and can make government benefits and services harder to access. Joining Christina Ruffini and Jeff Mason on Bloomberg This Weekend, Lowrey argues those burdens fall disproportionately on lower-income Americans and says simpler applications, better data sharing and streamlined tax filing could help reduce the cost. -------- More on Bloomberg Television and Markets Like this video? videos.title: AI May Transform How Humans Understand Animals
videos.description: Researchers are using AI to analyze vast collections of animal vocalizations, looking for patterns that could help humans better understand how species such as crows communicate. Bloomberg Weekend Senior Writer Morgan Meaker is on Bloomberg This Weekend and says the technology could reshape humans’ relationship with animals, but researchers warn it also raises ethical questions about privacy, exploitation and how those discoveries might be used. -------- More on Bloomberg Television and Markets Like this video? videos.title: Apple Bets on Foldable iPhone Under New CEO
videos.description: Apple CEO John Ternus is preparing for his first major product event since succeeding Tim Cook, with a foldable iPhone expected to headline the September 9 launch. Bloomberg Intelligence Senior Hardware Analyst Woo Jin Ho joins Christina Ruffini and Jeff Mason on Bloomberg This Weekend and says Ternus’ engineering background could bring renewed focus to hardware and expanding Apple’s ecosystem as smartphone upgrades become increasingly incremental. -------- More on Bloomberg Television and Markets Like this video?
